buildkit_address.description: gRPC address of a running buildkitd (e.g. `unix:///run/buildkit/buildkitd.sock`, `tcp://127.0.0.1:1234`, or `docker-container://buildkitd`). When set, auto-discovery is skipped. When unset, the `BUILDKIT_HOST` environment variable is used, then auto-discovery (if enabled).

buildkit_autodiscover.description: When `true` (default) and no explicit address or `BUILDKIT_HOST` is set, the provider attempts to discover a BuildKit endpoint: the Docker-engine embedded BuildKit via the daemon `/grpc` endpoint (OrbStack / Docker Desktop / Colima), then conventional local buildkitd sockets. Set to `false` to require an explicit address / `BUILDKIT_HOST` (recommended for hermetic CI).

docker_config.description: When `true` (default), registry credentials are resolved from the host's Docker config (`~/.docker/config.json`) and its configured credential helpers (e.g. `osxkeychain`, `ecr-login`, `gcr`) as a fallback after explicit `registry_auth` blocks. Set to `false` for fully hermetic credential resolution from `registry_auth` only.

embedded_buildkitd.description:
Controls the embedded `buildkitd` (Linux only). Tri-state:

- **unset (default)**: *auto* — if no endpoint is configured or discovered, the provider provisions and supervises a `buildkitd` for the lifetime of the provider. The `buildkitd` (and `rootlesskit` for unprivileged use) binaries are resolved from `BUILDKIT_EMBEDDED_BIN_DIR`, a provider-managed cache, the host `PATH`, or a pinned, checksum-verified download from the upstream GitHub releases (requires outbound network on first use; results are cached). On non-Linux hosts this fallback is unavailable.
- **`true`**: *force* — always use the embedded `buildkitd` (after an explicit `buildkit_address` / `BUILDKIT_HOST`), skipping auto-discovery.
- **`false`**: *never* — disable the embedded `buildkitd` entirely; resolution fails if no endpoint is configured or discovered.

Rootless use (non-root euid) requires user-namespace support and `/etc/subuid` + `/etc/subgid` entries for the user. Set `BUILDKIT_EMBEDDED_BIN_DIR` to a directory containing the binaries for fully air-gapped operation.

address.description: Registry host this credential applies to (e.g. `docker.io`, `ghcr.io`, `123.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com`). Scheme and trailing slash are ignored; Docker Hub aliases normalize to `docker.io`.

auth.description: Base64-encoded `username:password`, as stored in Docker config.

identity_token.description: Identity token used to obtain a registry access token (OAuth2 flows).

block.description: Explicit registry credentials. Each block authenticates to one registry host and takes precedence over Docker config for that host.

Builds container images and filesystem artifacts from a Dockerfile using BuildKit, without requiring the Docker daemon as the build mechanism. Connects to a local or remote `buildkitd` gRPC endpoint (with optional auto-discovery), and on Linux can automatically provision and supervise an embedded `buildkitd` (downloading a pinned, checksum-verified release) so builds work on hosts with no Docker or BuildKit preinstalled. Authenticates to registries via explicit credentials and/or the host Docker config.

artifact_dst_path.description: Destination path on the host for the extracted artifact.

artifact_path.description: Absolute host path of the produced artifact.

artifact_sha256.description: SHA256 of the produced artifact (file) used for drift detection.

artifact_src_path.description: Path inside the built stage filesystem to extract.

artifact_src_type.description: Either `zip` (default) or `directory`. When `zip` and `artifact_src_path` is a single file, the file is copied through verbatim (it is assumed already packaged, e.g. a pre-built `package.zip`); when it is a directory, the directory's contents are zipped.

build_args.description: Build arguments passed to the build.

build_context.description: Path to the Docker build context directory.

context_digest.description: Dockerignore-aware sha256 of the build context at build time.

dockerfile.description: Dockerfile path relative to the build context. Defaults to `Dockerfile`.

target.description: Optional multi-stage build target whose filesystem is exported.

triggers.description: Arbitrary map; any change forces the artifact to be rebuilt. Commonly wired to a `buildkit_context` digest.

block.description: Builds a Dockerfile via BuildKit and extracts an artifact (file as zip, or a directory) from the built stage onto the host filesystem.

context.description: Path to the build context directory.

context_digest.description: Dockerignore-aware sha256 of the build context at build time.

dockerfile.description: Path to the Dockerfile, relative to `context`.

forward_ssh_agent_socket.description: Forward the host `SSH_AUTH_SOCK` as the `default` ssh mount (`RUN --mount=type=ssh`).

image_digest.description: The sha256 digest of the built image manifest.

published.description: Resolved publish coordinates, including digest URLs.

secrets.description: Build secrets in `id => value` form, exposed via `RUN --mount=type=secret,id=...`.

secrets_base64.description: Build secrets in `id => base64(value)` form, decoded before use.

triggers.description: Arbitrary map; any change forces the image to be rebuilt.

block.description: Attach SBOM and/or provenance attestations to the build output.

insecure.description: Allow pushing over plain HTTP / untrusted TLS (sets `registry.insecure=true`). Also used for digest lookups during refresh.

push.description: Push to the registry. Defaults to `true`.

block.description: A registry/repository and the tags to publish. Multiple blocks publish to multiple targets in a single build. All publish blocks must agree on the `push` and `insecure` flags.

Builds a container image from a Dockerfile with BuildKit and optionally pushes it to one or more registries in a single build. Supports multi-platform builds, build args, labels, build secrets, SSH agent forwarding, cache import/export, and SBOM/provenance attestations. With no `publish` blocks the image is built (and a digest computed) but not pushed; with `publish` blocks all blocks must agree on the `push` and `insecure` flags.

digest.description: `sha256:`-prefixed digest of the included context content.

dockerignore.description: Optional path to a `.dockerignore` file to use instead of `<path>/.dockerignore`.

path.description: Path to the build context directory.

block.description: Computes a deterministic, dockerignore-aware SHA256 of a build context directory. Useful as a stable idempotency key (e.g. wired into a `buildkit_image` `triggers` map) so plans only change when the context content changes.

id.description: Synthetic id derived from the query.

insecure.description: Allow plain-HTTP / untrusted TLS when contacting the registry.

labels.description: Required label key/values; only images carrying all of them match.

most_recent_only.description: When `true`, return only the most recently created matching image.

platforms.description: Required platforms; only images supporting all of them match.

tag_pattern.description: Regular expression to filter tags. Empty matches all tags.

block.description: Queries a registry repository for images, filtered by a tag regex, required labels, and required platforms.

insecure.description: Allow plain-HTTP / untrusted TLS when contacting the registry.

platforms.description: Platforms present in the image (or index).

block.description: Resolves an existing image reference in a registry to its digest, platforms, labels, and creation time. Uses the provider's registry credentials.
